description: Free, no payment. Decodes a 17-character VIN with the US NHTSA vPIC database: make, model, model year, body, vehicle type, manufacturer and plant country, plus the check-digit test. Recalls and full specs are in the paid Vehicle Check. Next step (paid): Before you buy: Vehicle Check adds every official safety recall for the car, plus engine and transmission details.
name: vin_decode_decode
title: VIN Decoder: Make, model, year and origin from a VIN
